name: Leo
physical_description: A slender young man with fair skin and a soft oval face that rests in a faint calm smile. Large dark eyes, a small pointed nose, and short-to-medium messy dark teal-black hair with bangs across the forehead and longer strands framing the sides. Pretty-boy / bishounen rather than rugged.
main_outfit_description: An aristocratic gothic-formal ensemble - long black tailcoat with crimson lapels, gold filigree embroidery along the edges, and red interior lining visible at the back vents. Worn over a dark burgundy buttoned waistcoat with gold trim, a grey collared shirt, and a deep red cravat/ascot at the neck. Black slim-fit trousers with a small leather buckle strap on the right thigh, finished with black formal shoes featuring gold accents.

outfits.name: Christmas Fit
outfits.description: Cozy Santa-style Christmas outfit — bright red hooded coat with fluffy white fur trim along the hem, cuffs, and hood edge, decorated with a holly leaf and golden bell ornament at the collar. White drawstrings hang from the hood. A brown leather belt with a gold buckle cinches the waist. Matching red trousers and brown lace-up boots with white fur cuffs.

outfits.name: Black tuxedo
outfits.description: Classic black formal tuxedo — double-breasted black jacket with satin shawl lapels, worn over a grey waistcoat and crisp white dress shirt. A small black bow tie sits at the collar. Matching black tailored trousers and dark formal lace-up shoes complete the polished, refined look.
